name: Alastor Elias
source:
Consumption's two-sided persona makes him isolate from people. He resides in an old military complex that he purchased for a very low price. He enjoys... Drugs... Board games... Alcohol... Working out... Anything he enjoys, he can enjoy to excess... And hopes you will too. In between his normal interests, he works with various criminal organizations to stamp out the Temperance Corporation, secretly run by an Arch Angel. Consumption is happy to work with anyone who will help him achieve those goals. Even if they're from Hell.

[From Kickstarter]
